claims: The required Terraform test fails — `alerts/rules/peg-rule-definitions.tftest.hcl:68-69`: the test still requires `peg_slack_title` to contain `$alert.Annotations.summary` and `$alert.Annotations.resolved_summary`, but the new title template (`peg-message-templates.tf:14`) contains neither, so the `Test Peg rule definitions` CI step goes red

A breach that starts straight from an Error state loses its cause and its clear — `peg-alert-events.ts:109-110`, `:320-321`: `Error → Alerting` is classed as `error-recovered-alerting` and only closes the Error lane, so the alert lane is never opened. The active breach shows no measured cause and the details text (`peg-alert-explanation.ts:300`) replaces the rule's explanation; the later clear has no matching raise (`:346`) and shows with no duration and the wrong evidence (regression)

`Alerting → Error → Normal` leaves the breach open — `peg-alert-events.ts:344-356`: the Error→Normal recovery only closes the Error lane, so the earlier raise is shown as still active at `:356`, and the next cycle is corrupted: the next raise is ignored (`:341`) and the next clear pairs with the old raise, giving a wrong "lasted" and a missing raise row

Error → Pending isn't queried or recognised — `route.ts:51-54`, `peg-alert-events.ts:105-115`: for rules with a non-zero `for` wait, the Error lane never closes, shows "Monitoring failed" indefinitely and swallows the next failure

The Error lane brings back the failure that #1875 removed — `route.ts:43-83`: the new `current=Error` and `previous=Error` queries use the same limit of 1,001, and `peg-alert-events.ts:151` rejects the whole response when a frame goes over 1,000, so recent alerts could return 502 while monitoring is degraded; no test for it

Three fail-closed tests pass for the wrong reason — `route.test.ts:819, 832, 846`: `mockResolvedValue(json(...))` hands one `Response` object to three concurrent fetches, so the second `getReader()` read throws on a locked stream and the route returns 502 whatever it parsed

Wrong wording for rules without a source — `peg-alert-events.ts:230-242`: for rules with `source = ""`, `pegAlertSourceName("")` returns "Price source", so a failure reads "Grafana could not evaluate the Price source Peg rule"
The canonical runbook is now wrong — `docs/notes/peg-monitoring.md:118-119, 132-133`: it still says Slack titles carry the summary, and that history reads only fired and resolved transitions
`alert-rules-lint.test.mjs:1215-1220`: if the resource marker is renamed, `indexOf` returns −1 and `slice(-1, n)` returns `""`, so the "title has no summary" checks pass without checking anything
`alert-rules-lint.test.mjs:1215-1220`: the link checks search the whole file rather than the message resource
`recent-alerts.test.tsx:192`: `"sell price is below peg"` is never produced, so this assertion can't fail — dead code

judge_reasoning.3830366234: Review #1 names the same failure: tftest.hcl:68-69 still requires the summary annotations in peg_slack_title, but the new icon-only title has neither, so the CI Terraform test fails.
judge_reasoning.3830366243: Review #8 says docs/notes/peg-monitoring.md still claims Slack titles carry the summary.
judge_reasoning.3830366247: Review #4 says Error → Pending is neither queried nor recognised, so the Error lane never closes when a rule with a non-zero for duration recovers into Pending.
judge_reasoning.3830366547: Review #3 says Alerting → Error → Normal closes only the Error lane and leaves the earlier raise showing as an active breach.
judge_reasoning.3830366556: Review #4 describes the same orphaned error cycle through Pending: a 'Monitoring failed' row that stays open indefinitely.
judge_reasoning.3830371307: The review's first Minor bullet says the lint test's indexOf/slice extraction is unvalidated (a marker of -1 gives an empty string) and the link checks search the whole file instead of the message resource.
judge_reasoning.3830371315: Review #6 says mockResolvedValue shares one Response across the concurrent fetches, so the second read throws and the tests return 502 for the wrong reason.
judge_reasoning.3830371325: Review #2 says error-recovered-alerting closes only the Error lane and never opens the alert lane, which orphans the later clear in the pairing logic around line 352. This matches the error-recovered-alerting analysis in the defect.
judge_reasoning.3830371329: The review's second Minor bullet says 'sell price is below peg' is never produced, so the negative assertion in recent-alerts.test.tsx can't fail.
judge_reasoning.3830416461: Review #7 says rules with source = '' fall back to 'Price source' in the failure and recovery wording.

1.why: peg-rule-definitions.tftest.hcl:68-69 still requires $alert.Annotations.summary/resolved_summary in peg_slack_title, which the new title no longer contains; this is the known stale Terraform title assertion

2.why: transitionKind (peg-alert-events.ts:108-110) now classes Error→Alerting as error-recovered-alerting, which isOpening (:318-319) doesn't count as opening and cycleKey (:320-321) puts in the error lane, so no alert raise is opened. Before, the same row (fetched by current=Alerting) was a 'raised'. The later Alerting→Normal clear finds no raise (:344-346) and shows unpaired, with no duration and its own line as evidence. peg-alert-explanation.ts:300-301 replaces the rule explanation

3.why: Verified: error-recovered only deletes the ':error' key (:352), so the earlier alert raise stays in open and is shown as active (:356), and the next raise is ignored by !open.has (:341). Same as the known 'Error recovery leaves breach active'

4.why: Error→Pending returns null from transitionKind (:105-115) and route.ts:43-56 never queries previous=Error&current=Pending. Restates the known Pending-recovery items (:114, :116)

5.why: errorStateHistoryUrl copies the URL, so both new Error queries keep limit=1001 (route.ts:36,46). parseStateFrameTransitions throws on >1000 rows per frame (:151), and Promise.all/parse failure makes GET return 502. Peg rules set exec_err_state=Error (rules-peg.tf:20). This is the overflow #1875 removed for Pending, and no test covers Error overflow

6.why: Verified: json() runs once, so the one Response is shared by several fetches, and readBoundedGrafanaResponse calls body.getReader() (grafana-read.ts:65), which throws on the second read. Matches the known route.test.ts:819 item

7.why: pegAlertSourceName('') returns 'Price source' (peg-alert-copy.ts:49), and several peg rule definitions have source = "". Same as the known 'Label source-less evaluation failures by rule' (:230)

8.why: docs/notes/peg-monitoring.md still says Slack titles use the icon plus summary, and that history reads only fired and resolved transitions. Restates the known 'Keep the Peg runbook aligned with the new title'

9.why: Verified: if the peg_slack_title marker is missing, indexOf returns -1 and slice(-1, n) returns '', so the negative includes checks pass without checking anything. Assumed to be the known alert-rules-lint.test.mjs Functional Correctness item, though that one cites line 1289

10.why: The link checks do use templates.includes over the whole file (lint lines ~1261-1269), but the link strings only appear in the message resource today, so no incorrect result is shown. This is a preference about test scope

11.why: The fixture overrides the lead, and the failed-state explanation (peg-alert-explanation.ts:294-295) and the downside explanation never contain 'sell price is below peg', so the not.toContain can't fail. Matches the known recent-alerts.test.tsx:193 item
